caption:
Your ad passes the eyeball test. Your calendar says otherwise.

Run your current ad through The Stranger Test: three questions a scroller answers before they ever decide to call.

1. Who is this for: a named situation, stated exactly.
2. What do they get: an outcome a competitor can't copy-paste.
3. Why today: a real reason to act now.

Fail any one and the ad buys attention without buying customers.

rationale: Carousels reliably outperform other formats for save-worthy authority content, and this ships an acquisition-side framework (ad-message diagnostic) distinct from prior follow-up, CRM, and stage-based frameworks already covered.
